title: William Morris Society in the United States website
lede: A standard modern template with one Morris wallpaper panel behind a framed portrait and a serif capital heading.
summary: A Morris floral wallpaper panel, a framed portrait, serif capitals, and a white card with a soft shadow.

creator.name: William Morris Society in the United States

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Borderline: a Morris wallpaper panel and serif capitals, but the layout is a modern template with soft shadows and spaced sans-serif labels.

observed: A Morris floral wallpaper in sage, cream, and yellow fills a panel on the left third of the page.
A black-and-white photograph of Morris sits in a thick white frame with a soft drop shadow, overlapping the panel.
On the right, a white card on light grey holds a small spaced-capital label in salmon, “WILLIAM MORRIS” in large dark serif capitals, and body text in a sans-serif.
The “ABOUT US” button is slate blue with spaced white capitals and a soft shadow.
The navigation uses small, spaced sans-serif capitals.
interpretation: The pattern is decoration beside a modern card layout. The soft shadows and spaced sans-serif labels are counter-signs in the rubric.
Measured: shadow share 0.27, one chromatic hue, and a median border of 6 px from the photo frame.
borrow: Put a wallpaper panel behind a framed image instead of using a plain background colour.

images.alt: William Morris Society in the United States home page: a sage floral wallpaper panel at left behind a framed black-and-white portrait of Morris, and a white card with WILLIAM MORRIS in large serif capitals and an About Us button.
images.caption: First viewport of [morrissociety.org](https://morrissociety.org/), 28 September 2026.
